annotations.title: Get setup progress, integrations and feature status

description: Where this app has got to: the six setup steps and which are really done, worked out from data that has arrived, then the billing state, every Fictura feature toggle and whether it is on, and which third-party integrations (Stripe, RevenueCat, Slack, App Store Connect, …) are connected. Use it to check a setup step worked, and to check a feature is enabled before writing code that depends on it — a disabled tool is a server-side kill switch the SDK obeys.
name: get_setup_status
title: Get setup progress, integrations and feature status
